title: Concessive Clauses in Persian (اگرچه)
summary: Expressing contrast or concession using 'اگرچه' or 'با اینکه' (Although/Even though).
explanation: Place 'اگرچه' at the start of the concessive clause, often paired with 'اما' in the main clause.
rules: اگرچه + Concessive Clause, اما + Main Clause

example_translations.ex_conc_1: Although it was rainy, he/she went out.

common_error_explanations.err_conc_1: Use 'اگرچه' or 'با اینکه' to show contrast between two statements.
